answers.rationale: This requirement specifies the environmental conditions for the switchgear house, which is provided by others. It does not directly relate to a product from the catalog.

The requirement specifies metal-clad switchgear with drawout vacuum circuit breakers, which matches the description of CROWN-ARMV in the catalog. The finish color and number of sections can be customized as part of the ETO offering.
The number of independent trip coils is a detail that can be specified for the CROWN-ARMV switchgear, as it is an engineered-to-order product.
The requirement for current transformers with specific ratios and accuracy aligns with the CROWN-ARMV switchgear, which can include such components as part of its ETO configuration.
